decisions.reason: Because rye country bread closely builds on the firm's existing baking know-how, the firm can interpret early results and improve it, making a drop unlikely.
As a flagship stollen building directly on existing expertise and externally confirmed by a gold medal, it strongly fits the firm's absorptive capacity and is very likely to remain.
Dark barley malt rye bread is close to established bread-making knowledge, so early results can be read with existing expertise and the product improved rather than dropped.
Marzipan Christmas stollen is close to the firm's existing stollen offer, enabling the firm to use its prior knowledge to assess and refine the product.
